title.en: Feedback: principle, positive and negative feedback
title.kn: ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆ: ತತ್ವ, ಧನಾತ್ಮಕ ಮತ್ತು ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆ

hook.en: Bring a microphone close to its own speaker and you hear a loud howl. Sound from the output is reaching the input again: that is feedback, and today we learn to use it on purpose.

objectives.en: Draw the block diagram of a feedback amplifier

narration.en: Bring a microphone close to its own speaker and you hear a loud howl. Sound from the output is reaching the input again: that is feedback, and today we learn to use it on purpose.
narration.kn: ಮೈಕ್ರೋಫೋನ್ ಅನ್ನು ಅದರ ಸ್ಪೀಕರ್ ಹತ್ತಿರ ತಂದರೆ ಜೋರಾದ ಕೂಗು ಕೇಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್ ಧ್ವನಿ ಮತ್ತೆ ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್ ತಲುಪುತ್ತಿದೆ: ಇದೇ ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆ. ಇಂದು ಅದನ್ನು ಉದ್ದೇಶಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ಬಳಸುವುದನ್ನು ಕಲಿಯೋಣ.

body.en: Feedback is the process of returning a part of the output of an amplifier to its input. A feedback network returns a fraction $\beta$ (the feedback ratio) of the output $v_o$ to a mixer at the input. If the returned signal is in phase with the input, it adds to it: this is positive (regenerative) feedback, which increases the gain and is used in oscillators. If it is 180° out of phase, it subtracts: this is negative (degenerative) feedback, which reduces the gain but improves the amplifier in many ways. The product $A\beta$ is the loop gain.

points.en: Positive (regenerative): in phase, gain rises; oscillators
Negative (degenerative): out of phase, gain falls; amplifiers

narration.en: Feedback returns a fraction beta of the output to the input. In phase, it is positive feedback; out of phase, it is negative feedback.
narration.kn: ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ನ ಒಂದು ಭಾಗ β ಯನ್ನು ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗೆ ಹಿಂದಿರುಗಿಸುವುದೇ ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆ. ಒಂದೇ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದರೆ ಧನಾತ್ಮಕ, 180° ವಿರುದ್ಧ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದರೆ ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆ.

narration.en: On the board: the feedback loop.

say.en: The source vs enters a mixer. Its output vi drives the amplifier of gain A, which gives vo.
A feedback network takes a fraction beta of the output and returns it to the mixer. In negative feedback it is subtracted.
Write the three relations and eliminate vi. The gain with feedback is A over one plus A beta.

body.en: With negative feedback, $v_i = v_s - v_f$, $v_f = \beta v_o$ and $v_o = A v_i$. Eliminating $v_i$: $v_o = A(v_s - \beta v_o)$, so $A_f = v_o/v_s = A/(1 + A\beta)$. With positive feedback the signs add and $A_f = A/(1 - A\beta)$. When $A\beta = 1$ the positive-feedback gain becomes infinite: the circuit gives an output with no input and becomes an oscillator.

narration.en: With negative feedback the gain becomes A over one plus A beta. With positive feedback it is A over one minus A beta, and at A beta equal to one the circuit oscillates.
narration.kn: ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆಯಲ್ಲಿ Af = A/(1 + Aβ). ಧನಾತ್ಮಕದಲ್ಲಿ Af = A/(1 − Aβ); Aβ = 1 ಆದಾಗ ಮಂಡಲ ಆಂದೋಲನಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.

caption.en: Gain with negative feedback Af = A/(1 + Aβ) as the feedback fraction β (x-axis) increases.

tryThis.en: Set β = 0: there is no feedback, so Af = A.
Make Aβ large: compare Af with 1/β.
Change A from 100 to 200 at β = 0.1. How much does Af change?

narration.en: Gain with negative feedback Af = A/(1 + Aβ) as the feedback fraction β (x-axis) increases. Set β = 0: there is no feedback, so Af = A.

problem.en: An amplifier has an open-loop gain of 200. Negative feedback with β = 0.02 is applied. Find the loop gain and the gain with feedback.

steps.en: The gain has dropped by the factor 1 + Aβ = 5.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. An amplifier has an open-loop gain of 200. Negative feedback with β = 0.02 is applied. Find the loop gain and the gain with feedback.

problem.en: The same idea with positive feedback: A = 50 and β = 0.01. Find Af.

steps.en: Positive feedback doubled the gain; at Aβ = 1 it would oscillate.

narration.en: Let us work this out together. The same idea with positive feedback: A = 50 and β = 0.01. Find Af.

heading.en: Plus in the bottom means less

body.en: Negative feedback puts a PLUS in the denominator (1 + Aβ), so the gain goes DOWN. Positive feedback puts a MINUS there (1 − Aβ), so the gain goes UP, and blows up at Aβ = 1.

narration.en: Plus in the bottom means less. Negative feedback puts a PLUS in the denominator (1 + Aβ), so the gain goes DOWN. Positive feedback puts a MINUS there (1 − Aβ), so the gain goes UP, and blows up at Aβ = 1.

points.en: Feedback returns a fraction β of the output to the input.
points.kn: ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ನ β ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗೆ ಹಿಂದಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Negative feedback: Af = A/(1 + Aβ), used in amplifiers.
points.kn: ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆ: Af = A/(1 + Aβ), ವರ್ಧಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆ.

points.en: Positive feedback: Af = A/(1 − Aβ), used in oscillators.
points.kn: ಧನಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆ: Af = A/(1 − Aβ), ಆಂದೋಲಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆ.

homework.en: Draw the block diagram of a negative feedback amplifier and derive Af = A/(1 + Aβ).

narration.en: Recap. Feedback returns a fraction β of the output to the input. Negative feedback: Af = A/(1 + Aβ), used in amplifiers. Positive feedback: Af = A/(1 − Aβ), used in oscillators. Aβ is the loop gain.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆ ಔಟ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ನ β ಭಾಗವನ್ನು ಇನ್‌ಪುಟ್‌ಗೆ ಹಿಂದಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ಋಣಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆ: Af = A/(1 + Aβ), ವರ್ಧಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆ. ಧನಾತ್ಮಕ ಪ್ರತಿಪೋಷಣೆ: Af = A/(1 − Aβ), ಆಂದೋಲಕಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಕೆ. Aβ ಲೂಪ್ ವರ್ಧನೆ.
